text:
maya: Hey team — LaunchPad enablement week. We need to lock 2 x 90min customer office-hours next week to help with Dedicated migration + renewal touch. Proposed windows: Tue 10:00–11:30 PT or Wed 16:00–17:30 CET. Who can host and own invites?
chris: I can host Tue 10 PT. I’ll cover infra checklist + migration playbook. :thumbsup:
yusuf: Wed CET is ok for me too, but if we do Tue I need someone to handle billing/commit questions. @marcel-sales?
maya: cc @marcel-sales — Marcel, can you join the first 30m on Tue for the renewal convo?
marcel-sales: I can join Tue for the first 30m. Will follow up with the customer exec invite.
ellie: I’ll take Wed CET and draft the agenda. Can we open a quick registration form so we can triage attendee questions?
maya: Good call. Pre-read + registration will go out with the invite. Pre-read link (draft): https://redwood-internal.sheets/launchpad-pre-read — please add slides/questions.
chris: Agenda draft: 1) migration plan (20m) 2) Dedicated sizing (15m) 3) cost optimization + token estimates (20m) 4) live demo (20m) 5) Q&A (15m). Will add meeting note template: `Owner:`, `Action items:`, `Follow-up owner:`
yusuf: Customer asked for token-cost estimates and sample perf numbers. Ellie, can you own the cost slide?
ellie: Yep, cost slide + 20m demo. I’ll also pack a one-pager with sizing recs.
maya: Attendee list (so far): internal: chris, ellie, marcel-sales; customer: alice, bob, tom (infra), sara (security). Seat cap 12 — set waitlist.
ops-bot: Calendars updated — invites created for Tue 10:00 PT and Wed 16:00 CET. Meeting ID 962-123-888.
chris: Also adding a post-session NPS + short poll. tinyurl/launchpad-feedback for follow-up. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
yusuf: Noting renewal risk: renewal target EOM. If adoption milestones aren’t met in 30d mark risk = red. I’ll add adoption milestones to the playbook and share a one-pager by EOD.
ellie: I’ll synthesize any live Q&A into a shared doc: https://redwood-internal.docs/launchpad-qa — will tag action owners.
maya: Thanks everyone. Final invite will include pre-read, registration form, and feedback link. I’ll post the final agenda by tomorrow morning.
marcel-sales: Thx — I’ll prep the renewal talking points and bring any contract blockers to the session.
chris: Quick ops note — please enable recording and auto-transcript so we can push snippets to the CS playbook.
ops-bot: Recording enabled for Meeting ID 962-123-888. Transcripts will be saved to shared drive.
__notes: thread formatted as continuous Slack messages; root message is the first entry.
